texts.hab.1.1: LA carga que vió Habacuc profeta.
texts.hab.1.2: ¿Hasta cuándo, oh Jehová, clamaré, y no oirás; y daré voces á ti á causa de la violencia, y no salvarás?
texts.hab.1.3: ¿Por qué me haces ver iniquidad, y haces que mire molestia, y saco y violencia delante de mí, habiendo además quien levante pleito y contienda?
texts.hab.1.4: Por lo cual la ley es debilitada, y el juicio no sale verdadero: por cuanto el impío asedia al justo, por eso sale torcido el juicio.
texts.hab.1.5: Mirad en las gentes, y ved, y maravillaos pasmosamente; porque obra será hecha en vuestros días, que aun cuando se os contare, no la creeréis.
texts.hab.1.6: Porque he aquí, yo levanto los Caldeos, gente amarga y presurosa, que camina por la anchura de la tierra para poseer las habitaciones ajenas.
texts.hab.1.7: Espantosa es y terrible: de ella misma saldrá su derecho y su grandeza.
texts.hab.1.8: Y serán sus caballos más ligeros que tigres, y más agudos que lobos de tarde; y sus jinetes se multiplicarán: vendrán de lejos sus caballeros, y volarán como águilas que se apresuran á la comida.
texts.hab.1.9: Toda ella vendrá á la presa: delante su sus caras viento solano; y juntará cautivos como arena.
texts.hab.1.10: Y escarnecerá de los reyes, y de los príncipes hará burla: reiráse de toda fortaleza, y amontonará polvo, y la tomará.
texts.hab.1.11: Luego mudará espíritu, y pasará adelante, y ofenderá atribuyendo esta su potencia á su dios.
texts.hab.1.12: ¿No eres tú desde el principio, oh Jehová, Dios mío, Santo mío? No moriremos. Oh Jehová, para juicio lo pusiste; y tú, oh Roca, lo fundaste para castigar.
texts.hab.1.13: Muy limpio eres de ojos para ver el mal, ni puedes ver el agravio: ¿por qué ves los menospreciadores, y callas cuando destruye el impío al más justo que él.
texts.hab.1.14: Y haces que sean los hombres como los peces de la mar, como reptiles que no tienen señor?
texts.hab.1.15: Sacará á todos con anzuelo, cogerálos con su red, y juntarálos en su aljerife: por lo cual se holgará y hará alegrías.
texts.hab.1.16: Por esto hará sacrificios á su red, y ofrecerá sahumerios á su aljerife: porque con ellos engordó su porción, y engrasó su comida.
texts.hab.1.17: ¿Vaciará por eso su red, ó tendrá piedad de matar gentes continuamente?
texts.hab.2.1: SOBRE mi guarda estaré, y sobre la fortaleza afirmaré el pie, y atalayaré para ver qué hablará en mí, y qué tengo de responder á mi pregunta.
texts.hab.2.2: Y Jehová me respondió, y dijo: Escribe la visión, y declárala en tablas, para que corra el que leyere en ella.
texts.hab.2.3: Aunque la visión tardará aún por tiempo, mas al fin hablará, y no mentirá: aunque se tardare, espéralo, que sin duda vendrá; no tardará.
texts.hab.2.4: He aquí se enorgullece aquel cuya alma no es derecha en él: mas el justo en su fe vivirá.
texts.hab.2.5: Y también, por cuanto peca por el vino, es un hombre soberbio, y no permanecerá: que ensanchó como el infierno su alma, y es como la muerte, que no se hartará: antes reunió á sí todas las gentes, y amontonó á sí todos los pueblos.
texts.hab.2.6: ¿No han de levantar todos estos sobre él parábola, y sarcasmos contra él? Y dirán: ­Ay del que multiplicó lo que no era suyo! ¿Y hasta cuándo había de amontonar sobre sí espeso lodo?
texts.hab.2.7: ¿No se levantarán de repente los que te han de morder, y se despertarán los que te han de quitar de tu lugar, y serás á ellos por rapiña?
texts.hab.2.8: Porque tú has despojado muchas gentes, todos los otros pueblos te despojarán; á causa de las sangres humanas, y robos de la tierra, de las ciudades y de todos los que moraban en ellas.
texts.hab.2.9: Ay del que codicia maligna codicia para su casa, por poner en alto su nido, por escaparse del poder del mal!
texts.hab.2.10: Tomaste consejo vergonzoso para tu casa, asolaste muchos pueblos, y has pecado contra tu vida.
texts.hab.2.11: Porque la piedra clamará desde el muro, y la tabla del enmaderado le responderá.
texts.hab.2.12: Ay del que edifica la ciudad con sangres, y del que funda la villa con iniquidad!
texts.hab.2.13: ¿No es esto de Jehová de los ejércitos? Los pueblos pues trabajarán para el fuego, y las gentes se fatigarán en vano.
texts.hab.2.14: Porque la tierra será llena de conocimiento de la gloria de Jehová, como las aguas cubren la mar.
texts.hab.2.15: Ay del que da de beber á sus compañeros, que les acercas tu hiel y embriagas, para mirar sus desnudeces!
texts.hab.2.16: Haste llenado de deshonra más que de honra: bebe tú también, y serás descubierto; el cáliz de la mano derecha de Jehová volverá sobre ti, y vómito de afrenta sobre tu gloria.
texts.hab.2.17: Porque la rapiña del Líbano caerá sobre ti, y la destrucción de las fieras lo quebrantará; á causa de las sangres humanas, y del robo de la tierra, de las ciudades, y de todos los que en ellas moraban.
texts.hab.2.18: ¿De qué sirve la escultura que esculpió el que la hizo? ¿la estatua de fundición, que enseña mentira, para que haciendo imágenes mudas confíe el hacedor en su obra?
texts.hab.2.19: Ay del que dice al palo; Despiértate; y á la piedra muda: Levántate! ¿Podrá él enseñar? He aquí él está cubierto de oro y plata, y no hay dentro de él espíritu.
texts.hab.2.20: Mas Jehová está en su santo templo: calle delante de él toda la tierra.
texts.hab.3.1: ORACION de Habacuc profeta, sobre Sigionoth.
texts.hab.3.2: Oh Jehová, oído he tu palabra, y temí: Oh Jehová, aviva tu obra en medio de los tiempos, En medio de los tiempos hazla conocer; En la ira acuérdate de la misericordia.
texts.hab.3.3: Dios vendrá de Temán, Y el Santo del monte de Parán, (Selah.) Su gloria cubrió los cielos, Y la tierra se llenó de su alabanza.
texts.hab.3.4: Y el resplandor fué como la luz; Rayos brillantes salían de su mano; Y allí estaba escondida su fortaleza.
texts.hab.3.5: Delante de su rostro iba mortandad, Y á sus pies salían carbones encendidos.
texts.hab.3.6: Paróse, y midió la tierra: Miró, é hizo temblar las gentes; Y los montes antiguos fueron desmenuzados, Los collados antiguos se humillaron á él. Sus caminos son eternos.
texts.hab.3.7: He visto las tiendas de Cushán en aflicción; Las tiendas de la tierra de Madián temblaron.
texts.hab.3.8: ¿Airóse Jehová contra los ríos? ¿Contra los ríos fué tu enojo? ¿Tu ira contra la mar, Cuando subiste sobre tus caballos, Y sobre tus carros de salud?
texts.hab.3.9: Descubrióse enteramente tu arco, Los juramentos á las tribus, palabra segura. (Selah.) Hendiste la tierra con ríos.
texts.hab.3.10: Viéronte, y tuvieron temor los montes: Pasó la inundación de las aguas: El abismo dió su voz, La hondura alzó sus manos.
texts.hab.3.11: El sol y la luna se pararon en su estancia: A la luz de tus saetas anduvieron, Y al resplandor de tu fulgente lanza.
texts.hab.3.12: Con ira hollaste la tierra, Con furor trillaste las gentes.
texts.hab.3.13: Saliste para salvar tu pueblo, Para salvar con tu ungido. Traspasaste la cabeza de la casa del impío, Desnudando el cimiento hasta el cuello. (Selah.)
texts.hab.3.14: Horadaste con sus báculos las cabezas de sus villas, Que como tempestad acometieron para derramarme: Su orgullo era como para devorar al pobre encubiertamente.
texts.hab.3.15: Hiciste camino en la mar á tu caballos, Por montón de grandes aguas.
texts.hab.3.16: Oí, y tembló mi vientre; A la voz se batieron mis labios; Pudrición se entró en mis huesos, y en mi asiento me estremecí; Si bien estaré quieto en el día de la angustia, Cuando suba al pueblo el que lo invadirá con sus tropas.
texts.hab.3.17: Aunque la higuera no florecerá, Ni en las vides habrá frutos; Mentirá la obra de la oliva, Y los labrados no darán mantenimiento. Y las ovejas serán quitadas de la majada, Y no habrá vacas en los corrales;
texts.hab.3.18: Con todo yo me alegraré en Jehová, Y me gozaré en el Dios de mi salud.
texts.hab.3.19: Jehová el Señor es mi fortaleza, El cual pondrá mis pies como de ciervas, Y me hará andar sobre mis alturas

texts.hab.1.1: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
texts.hab.1.2: O Jehovah, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear? I cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save.
texts.hab.1.3: Why dost thou show me iniquity, and look upon perverseness? for destruction and violence are before me; and there is strife, and contention riseth up.
texts.hab.1.4: Therefore the law is slacked, and justice doth never go forth; for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore justice goeth forth perverted.
texts.hab.1.5: Behold ye among the nations, and look, and wonder marvellously; for I am working a work in your days, which ye will not believe though it be told you.
texts.hab.1.6: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the breadth of the earth, to possess dwelling-places that are not theirs.
texts.hab.1.7: They are terrible and dreadful; their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
texts.hab.1.8: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves; and their horsemen press proudly on: yea, their horsemen come from far; they fly as an eagle that hasteth to devour.
texts.hab.1.9: They come all of them for violence; the set of their faces is forwards; and they gather captives as the sand.
texts.hab.1.10: Yea, he scoffeth at kings, and princes are a derision unto him; he derideth every stronghold; for he heapeth up dust, and taketh it.
texts.hab.1.11: Then shall he sweep by [as] a wind, and shall pass over, and be guilty, [even] he whose might is his god.
texts.hab.1.12: Art not thou from everlasting, O Jehovah my God, my Holy One? we shall not die. O Jehovah, thou hast ordained him for judgment; and thou, O Rock, hast established him for correction.
texts.hab.1.13: Thou that art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and that canst not look on perverseness, wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy peace when the wicked swalloweth up the man that is more righteous than he;
texts.hab.1.14: and makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
texts.hab.1.15: He taketh up all of them with the angle, he catcheth them in his net, and gathereth them in his drag: therefore he rejoiceth and is glad.
texts.hab.1.16: Therefore he sacrificeth unto his net, and burneth incense unto his drag; because by them his portion is fat, and his food plenteous.
texts.hab.1.17: Shall he therefore empty his net, and spare not to slay the nations continually?
texts.hab.2.1: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will look forth to see what he will speak with me, and what I shall answer concerning my complaint.
texts.hab.2.2: And Jehovah answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tablets, that he may run that readeth it.
texts.hab.2.3: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hasteth toward the end, and shall not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not delay.
texts.hab.2.4: Behold, his soul is puffed up, it is not upright in him; but the righteous shall live by his faith.
texts.hab.2.5: Yea, moreover, wine is treacherous, a haughty man, that keepeth not at home; who enlargeth his desire as Sheol, and he is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all peoples.
texts.hab.2.6: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and that ladeth himself with pledges!
texts.hab.2.7: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booty unto them?
texts.hab.2.8: Because thou hast plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples shall plunder thee, because of men's blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all that dwell therein.
texts.hab.2.9: Woe to him that getteth an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!
texts.hab.2.10: Thou hast devised shame to thy house, by cutting off many peoples, and hast sinned against thy soul.
texts.hab.2.11: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
texts.hab.2.12: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and establisheth a city by iniquity!
texts.hab.2.13: Behold, is it not of Jehovah of hosts that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
texts.hab.2.14: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Jehovah, as the waters cover the sea.
texts.hab.2.15: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbor drink, [to thee] that addest thy venom, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
texts.hab.2.16: Thou art filled with shame, and not glory: drink thou also, and be as one uncircumcised; the cup of Jehovah's right hand shall come round unto thee, and foul shame shall be upon thy glory.
texts.hab.2.17: For the violence done to Lebanon shall cover thee, and the destruction of the beasts, which made them afraid; because of men's blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all that dwell therein.
texts.hab.2.18: What profiteth the graven image, that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he that fashioneth its form trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
texts.hab.2.19: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise! Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
texts.hab.2.20: But Jehovah is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
texts.hab.3.1: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, set to Shigionoth.
texts.hab.3.2: O Jehovah, I have heard the report of thee, and am afraid: O Jehovah, revive thy work in the midst of the years; In the midst of the years make it known; In wrath remember mercy.
texts.hab.3.3: God came from Teman, And the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, And the earth was full of his praise.
texts.hab.3.4: And [his] brightness was as the light; He had rays [coming forth] from his hand; And there was the hiding of his power.
texts.hab.3.5: Before him went the pestilence, And fiery bolts went forth at his feet.
texts.hab.3.6: He stood, and measured the earth; He beheld, and drove asunder the nations; And the eternal mountains were scattered; The everlasting hills did bow; His goings were [as] of old.
texts.hab.3.7: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
texts.hab.3.8: Was Jehovah displeased with the rivers? Was thine anger against the rivers, Or thy wrath against the sea, That thou didst ride upon thy horses, Upon thy chariots of salvation?
texts.hab.3.9: Thy bow was made quite bare; The oaths to the tribes were a [sure] word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
texts.hab.3.10: The mountains saw thee, and were afraid; The tempest of waters passed by; The deep uttered its voice, And lifted up its hands on high.
texts.hab.3.11: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation, At the light of thine arrows as they went, At the shining of thy glittering spear.
texts.hab.3.12: Thou didst march though the land in indignation; Thou didst thresh the nations in anger.
texts.hab.3.13: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, For the salvation of thine anointed; Thou woundest the head out of the house of the wicked man, Laying bare the foundation even unto the neck. Selah.
texts.hab.3.14: Thou didst pierce with his own staves the head of his warriors: They came as a whirlwind to scatter me; Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
texts.hab.3.15: Thou didst tread the sea with thy horses, The heap of mighty waters.
texts.hab.3.16: I heard, and my body trembled, My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entereth into my bones, and I tremble in my place; Because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, For the coming up of the people that invadeth us.
texts.hab.3.17: For though the fig-tree shall not flourish, Neither shall fruit be in the vines; The labor of the olive shall fail, And the fields shall yield no food; The flock shall be cut off from the fold, And there shall be no herd in the stalls:
texts.hab.3.18: Yet I will rejoice in Jehovah, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
texts.hab.3.19: Jehovah, the Lord, is my strength; And he maketh my feet like hinds' [feet], And will make me to walk upon my high places.

texts.hab.1.1: Oracle révélé à Habakuk, le prophète.
texts.hab.1.2: Jusqu'à quand, ô Eternel?... J'ai crié, Et tu n'écoutes pas! J'ai crié vers toi à la violence, Et tu ne secours pas!
texts.hab.1.3: Pourquoi me fais-tu voir l'iniquité, Et contemples-tu l'injustice? Pourquoi l'oppression et la violence sont-elles devant moi? Il y a des querelles, et la discorde s'élève.
texts.hab.1.4: Aussi la loi n'a point de vie, La justice n'a point de force; Car le méchant triomphe du juste, Et l'on rend des jugements iniques.
texts.hab.1.5: Jetez les yeux parmi les nations, regardez, Et soyez saisis d'étonnement, d'épouvante! Car je vais faire en vos jours une oeuvre, Que vous ne croiriez pas si on la racontait.
texts.hab.1.6: Voici, je vais susciter les Chaldéens, Peuple furibond et impétueux, Qui traverse de vastes étendues de pays, Pour s'emparer de demeures qui ne sont pas à lui.
texts.hab.1.7: Il est terrible et formidable; De lui seul viennent son droit et sa grandeur.
texts.hab.1.8: Ses chevaux sont plus rapides que les léopards, Plus agiles que les loups du soir, Et ses cavaliers s'avancent avec orgueil; Ses cavaliers arrivent de loin, Ils volent comme l'aigle qui fond sur sa proie.
texts.hab.1.9: Tout ce peuple vient pour se livrer au pillage; Ses regards avides se portent en avant, Et il assemble des prisonniers comme du sable.
texts.hab.1.10: Il se moque des rois, Et les princes font l'objet de ses railleries; Il se rit de toutes les forteresses, Il amoncelle de la terre, et il les prend.
texts.hab.1.11: Alors son ardeur redouble, Il poursuit sa marche, et il se rend coupable. Sa force à lui, voilà son dieu!
texts.hab.1.12: N'es-tu pas de toute éternité, Eternel, mon Dieu, mon Saint? Nous ne mourrons pas! O Eternel, tu as établi ce peuple pour exercer tes jugements; O mon rocher, tu l'as suscité pour infliger tes châtiments.
texts.hab.1.13: Tes yeux sont trop purs pour voir le mal, Et tu ne peux pas regarder l'iniquité. Pourquoi regarderais-tu les perfides, et te tairais-tu, Quand le méchant dévore celui qui est plus juste que lui?
texts.hab.1.14: Traiterais-tu l'homme comme les poissons de la mer, Comme le reptile qui n'a point de maître?
texts.hab.1.15: Il les fait tous monter avec l'hameçon, Il les attire dans son filet, Il les assemble dans ses rets: Aussi est-il dans la joie et dans l'allégresse.
texts.hab.1.16: C'est pourquoi il sacrifie à son filet, Il offre de l'encens à ses rets; Car par eux sa portion est grasse, Et sa nourriture succulente.
texts.hab.1.17: Videra-t-il pour cela son filet, Et toujours égorgera-t-il sans pitié les nations?
texts.hab.2.1: J'étais à mon poste, Et je me tenais sur la tour; Je veillais, pour voir ce que l'Eternel me dirait, Et ce que je répliquerais après ma plainte.
texts.hab.2.2: L'Eternel m'adressa la parole, et il dit: Ecris la prophétie: Grave-la sur des tables, Afin qu'on la lise couramment.
texts.hab.2.3: Car c'est une prophétie dont le temps est déjà fixé, Elle marche vers son terme, et elle ne mentira pas; Si elle tarde, attends-la, Car elle s'accomplira, elle s'accomplira certainement.
texts.hab.2.4: Voici, son âme s'est enflée, elle n'est pas droite en lui; Mais le juste vivra par sa foi.
texts.hab.2.5: Pareil à celui qui est ivre et arrogant, L'orgueilleux ne demeure pas tranquille; Il élargit sa bouche comme le séjour des morts, Il est insatiable comme la mort; Il attire à lui toutes les nations, Il assemble auprès de lui tous les peuples.
texts.hab.2.6: Ne sera-t-il pas pour tous un sujet de sarcasme, De railleries et d'énigmes? On dira: Malheur à celui qui accumule ce qui n'est pas à lui! Jusques à quand?... Malheur à celui qui augmente le fardeau de ses dettes!
texts.hab.2.7: Tes créanciers ne se lèveront-ils pas soudain? Tes oppresseurs ne se réveilleront-ils pas? Et tu deviendras leur proie.
texts.hab.2.8: Parce que tu as pillé beaucoup de nations, Tout le reste des peuples te pillera; Car tu as répandu le sang des hommes, Tu as commis des violences dans le pays, Contre la ville et tous ses habitants.
texts.hab.2.9: Malheur à celui qui amasse pour sa maison des gains iniques, Afin de placer son nid dans un lieu élevé, Pour se garantir de la main du malheur!
texts.hab.2.10: C'est l'opprobre de ta maison que tu as résolu, En détruisant des peuples nombreux, Et c'est contre toi-même que tu as péché.
texts.hab.2.11: Car la pierre crie du milieu de la muraille, Et le bois qui lie la charpente lui répond.
texts.hab.2.12: Malheur à celui qui bâtit une ville avec le sang, Qui fonde une ville avec l'iniquité!
texts.hab.2.13: Voici, quand l'Eternel des armées l'a résolu, Les peuples travaillent pour le feu, Les nations se fatiguent en vain.
texts.hab.2.14: Car la terre sera remplie de la connaissance de la gloire de l'Eternel, Comme le fond de la mer par les eaux qui le couvrent.
texts.hab.2.15: Malheur à celui qui fait boire son prochain, A toi qui verses ton outre et qui l'enivres, Afin de voir sa nudité!
texts.hab.2.16: Tu seras rassasié de honte plus que de gloire; Bois aussi toi-même, et découvre-toi! La coupe de la droite de l'Eternel se tournera vers toi, Et l'ignominie souillera ta gloire.
texts.hab.2.17: Car les violences contre le Liban retomberont sur toi, Et les ravages des bêtes t'effraieront, Parce que tu as répandu le sang des hommes, Et commis des violences dans le pays, Contre la ville et tous ses habitants.
texts.hab.2.18: A quoi sert une image taillée, pour qu'un ouvrier la taille? A quoi sert une image en fonte et qui enseigne le mensonge, Pour que l'ouvrier qui l'a faite place en elle sa confiance, Tandis qu'il fabrique des idoles muettes?
texts.hab.2.19: Malheur à celui qui dit au bois: Lève-toi! A une pierre muette: Réveille-toi! Donnera-t-elle instruction? Voici, elle est garnie d'or et d'argent, Mais il n'y a point en elle un esprit qui l'anime.
texts.hab.2.20: L'Eternel est dans son saint temple. Que toute la terre fasse silence devant lui!
texts.hab.3.1: Prière d'Habakuk, le prophète. Sur le mode des complaintes.
texts.hab.3.2: Eternel, j'ai entendu ce que tu as annoncé, je suis saisi de crainte. Accomplis ton oeuvre dans le cours des années, ô Eternel! Dans le cours des années manifeste-la! Mais dans ta colère souviens-toi de tes compassions!
texts.hab.3.3: Dieu vient de Théman, Le Saint vient de la montagne de Paran... Pause. Sa majesté couvre les cieux, Et sa gloire remplit la terre.
texts.hab.3.4: C'est comme l'éclat de la lumière; Des rayons partent de sa main; Là réside sa force.
texts.hab.3.5: Devant lui marche la peste, Et la peste est sur ses traces.
texts.hab.3.6: Il s'arrête, et de l'oeil il mesure la terre; Il regarde, et il fait trembler les nations; Les montagnes éternelles se brisent, Les collines antiques s'abaissent; Les sentiers d'autrefois s'ouvrent devant lui.
texts.hab.3.7: Je vois dans la détresse les tentes de l'Ethiopie, Et les tentes du pays de Madian sont dans l'épouvante.
texts.hab.3.8: L'Eternel est-il irrité contre les fleuves? Est-ce contre les fleuves que s'enflamme ta colère, Contre la mer que se répand ta fureur, Pour que tu sois monté sur tes chevaux, Sur ton char de victoire?
texts.hab.3.9: Ton arc est mis à nu; Les malédictions sont les traits de ta parole... Pause. Tu fends la terre pour donner cours aux fleuves.
texts.hab.3.10: A ton aspect, les montagnes tremblent; Des torrents d'eau se précipitent; L'abîme fait entendre sa voix, Il lève ses mains en haut.
texts.hab.3.11: Le soleil et la lune s'arrêtent dans leur demeure, A la lumière de tes flèches qui partent, A la clarté de ta lance qui brille.
texts.hab.3.12: Tu parcours la terre dans ta fureur, Tu écrases les nations dans ta colère.
texts.hab.3.13: Tu sors pour délivrer ton peuple, Pour délivrer ton oint; Tu brises le faîte de la maison du méchant, Tu la détruis de fond en comble. Pause.
texts.hab.3.14: Tu perces de tes traits la tête de ses chefs, Qui se précipitent comme la tempête pour me disperser, Poussant des cris de joie, Comme s'ils dévoraient déjà le malheureux dans leur repaire.
texts.hab.3.15: Avec tes chevaux tu foules la mer, La boue des grandes eaux.
texts.hab.3.16: J'ai entendu... Et mes entrailles sont émues. A cette voix, mes lèvres frémissent, Mes os se consument, Et mes genoux chancellent: En silence je dois attendre le jour de la détresse, Le jour où l'oppresseur marchera contre le peuple.
texts.hab.3.17: Car le figuier ne fleurira pas, La vigne ne produira rien, Le fruit de l'olivier manquera, Les champs ne donneront pas de nourriture; Les brebis disparaîtront du pâturage, Et il n'y aura plus de boeufs dans les étables.
texts.hab.3.18: Toutefois, je veux me réjouir en l'Eternel, Je veux me réjouir dans le Dieu de mon salut.
texts.hab.3.19: L'Eternel, le Seigneur, est ma force; Il rend mes pieds semblables à ceux des biches, Et il me fait marcher sur mes lieux élevés. Au chef des chantres. Avec instruments à cordes.

texts.hab.1.1: Dies ist die Last, welche der Prophet Habakuk gesehen hat.
texts.hab.1.2: HERR, wie lange soll ich schreien, und du willst mich nicht hören? Wie lange soll ich zu dir rufen über Frevel, und du willst nicht helfen?
texts.hab.1.3: Warum lässest du mich Mühsal sehen und siehest dem Jammer zu? Raub und Frevel sind vor mir. Es geht Gewalt über Recht.
texts.hab.1.4: Darum ist das Gesetz ohnmächtig, und keine rechte Sache kann gewinnen. Denn der Gottlose übervorteilt den Gerechten; darum ergehen verkehrte Urteile.
texts.hab.1.5: Schaut unter den Heiden, seht und verwundert euch! denn ich will etwas tun zu euren Zeiten, welches ihr nicht glauben werdet, wenn man davon sagen wird.
texts.hab.1.6: Denn siehe, ich will die Chaldäer erwecken, ein bitteres und schnelles Volk, welches ziehen wird, soweit die Erde ist, Wohnungen einzunehmen, die nicht sein sind,
texts.hab.1.7: und wird grausam und schrecklich sein; das da gebeut und zwingt, wie es will.
texts.hab.1.8: Ihre Rosse sind schneller denn die Parder und behender denn die Wölfe des Abends. Ihre Reiter ziehen in großen Haufen von ferne daher, als flögen sie, wie die Adler eilen zum Aas.
texts.hab.1.9: Sie kommen allesamt, daß sie Schaden tun; wo sie hin wollen, reißen sie hindurch wie ein Ostwind und werden Gefangene zusammenraffen wie Sand.
texts.hab.1.10: Sie werden der Könige spotten, und der Fürsten werden sie lachen. Alle Festungen werden ihnen ein Scherz sein; denn sie werden Erde aufschütten und sie gewinnen.
texts.hab.1.11: Alsdann werden sie einen neuen Mut nehmen, werden fortfahren und sich versündigen; also muß ihre Macht ihr Gott sein.
texts.hab.1.12: Aber du, HERR, mein Gott, mein Heiliger, der du von Ewigkeit her bist, laß uns nicht sterben; sondern laß sie uns, o HERR, nur eine Strafe sein und laß sie, o unser Hort, uns nur züchtigen!
texts.hab.1.13: Deine Augen sind rein, daß du Übles nicht sehen magst, und dem Jammer kannst du nicht zusehen. Warum siehst du denn den Räubern zu und schweigst, daß der Gottlose verschlingt den, der frömmer als er ist,
texts.hab.1.14: und lässest die Menschen gehen wie Fische im Meer, wie Gewürm, das keinen HERRN hat?
texts.hab.1.15: Sie ziehen alles mit dem Haken und fangen's mit ihrem Netz und sammeln's mit ihrem Garn; des freuen sie sich und sind fröhlich.
texts.hab.1.16: Darum opfern sie ihrem Netz und räuchern ihrem Garn, weil durch diese ihr Teil so fett und ihre Speise so völlig geworden ist.
texts.hab.1.17: Sollen sie derhalben ihr Netz immerdar auswerfen und nicht aufhören, Völker zu erwürgen?
texts.hab.2.1: Hier stehe ich auf meiner Hut und trete auf meine Feste und schaue und sehe zu, was mir gesagt werde, und was meine Antwort sein sollte auf mein Rechten.
texts.hab.2.2: Der HERR aber antwortet mir und spricht: Schreib das Gesicht und male es auf eine Tafel, daß es lesen könne, wer vorüberläuft!
texts.hab.2.3: Die Weissagung wird ja noch erfüllt werden zu seiner Zeit und endlich frei an den Tag kommen und nicht ausbleiben. Ob sie aber verzieht, so harre ihrer: sie wird gewiß kommen und nicht verziehen.
texts.hab.2.4: Siehe, wer halsstarrig ist, der wird keine Ruhe in seinem Herzen haben; der Gerechte aber wird seines Glaubens leben.
texts.hab.2.5: Aber der Wein betrügt den stolzen Mann, daß er nicht rasten kann, welcher seine Seele aufsperrt wie die Hölle und ist gerade wie der Tod, der nicht zu sättigen ist, sondern rafft zu sich alle Heiden und sammelt zu sich alle Völker.
texts.hab.2.6: Was gilt's aber? diese alle werden einen Spruch von ihm machen und eine Sage und Sprichwort und werden sagen: Weh dem, der sein Gut mehrt mit fremden Gut! Wie lange wird's währen, und ladet nur viel Schulden auf sich?
texts.hab.2.7: O wie plötzlich werden aufstehen die dich beißen, und erwachen, die dich wegstoßen! und du mußt ihnen zuteil werden.
texts.hab.2.8: Denn du hast viele Heiden beraubt; so werden dich wieder berauben alle übrigen von den Völkern um des Menschenbluts willen und um des Frevels willen, im Lande und in der Stadt und an allen, die darin wohnen, begangen.
texts.hab.2.9: Weh dem, der da geizt zum Unglück seines Hauses, auf daß er sein Nest in die Höhe lege, daß er dem Unfall entrinne!
texts.hab.2.10: Aber dein Ratschlag wird zur Schande deines Hauses geraten; denn du hast zu viele Völker zerschlagen und hast mit allem Mutwillen gesündigt.
texts.hab.2.11: Denn auch die Steine in der Mauer werden schreien, und die Sparren am Balkenwerk werden ihnen antworten.
texts.hab.2.12: Weh dem, der die Stadt mit Blut baut und richtet die Stadt mit Unrecht zu!
texts.hab.2.13: Wird's nicht also vom HERRN Zebaoth geschehen: was die Völker gearbeitet haben, muß mit Feuer verbrennen, und daran die Leute müde geworden sind, das muß verloren sein?
texts.hab.2.14: Denn die Erde wird voll werden von Erkenntnis der Ehre des HERRN, wie Wasser das Meer bedeckt.
texts.hab.2.15: Weh dir, der du deinem Nächsten einschenkst und mischest deinen Grimm darunter und ihn trunken machst, daß du sein Blöße sehest!
texts.hab.2.16: Du hast dich gesättigt mit Schande und nicht mit Ehre. So saufe du nun auch, daß du taumelst! denn zu dir wird umgehen der Kelch in der Rechten des HERRN, und mußt eitel Schande haben für deine Herrlichkeit.
texts.hab.2.17: Denn der Frevel, am Libanon begangen, wird dich überfallen, und die verstörten Tiere werden dich schrecken um des Menschenbluts willen und um des Frevels willen, im Lande und in der Stadt und an allen, die darin wohnen, begangen.
texts.hab.2.18: Was wird dann helfen das Bild, das sein Meister gebildet hat, und das falsche gegossene Bild, darauf sich verläßt sein Meister, daß er stumme Götzen machte?
texts.hab.2.19: Weh dem, der zum Holz spricht: Wache auf! und zum stummen Steine: Stehe auf! Wie sollte es lehren? Siehe, es ist mit Gold und Silber überzogen und ist kein Odem in ihm.
texts.hab.2.20: Aber der HERR ist in seinem heiligen Tempel. Es sei vor ihm still alle Welt!
texts.hab.3.1: Dies ist das Gebet des Propheten Habakuk für die Unschuldigen:
texts.hab.3.2: HERR, ich habe dein Gerücht gehört, daß ich mich entsetze. HERR, mache dein Werk lebendig mitten in den Jahren und laß es kund werden mitten in den Jahren. Wenn Trübsal da ist, so denke der Barmherzigkeit.
texts.hab.3.3: Gott kam vom Mittag und der Heilige vom Gebirge Pharan. (Sela.) Seines Lobes war der Himmel voll, und seiner Ehre war die Erde voll.
texts.hab.3.4: Sein Glanz war wie ein Licht; Strahlen gingen von seinen Händen; darin war verborgen seine Macht.
texts.hab.3.5: Vor ihm her ging Pestilenz, und Plage ging aus, wo er hin trat.
texts.hab.3.6: Er stand und maß die Erde, er schaute und machte beben die Heiden, daß zerschmettert wurden die Berge, die von alters her sind, und sich bücken mußten die ewigen Hügel, da er wie vor alters einherzog.
texts.hab.3.7: Ich sah der Mohren Hütten in Not und der Midianiter Gezelte betrübt.
texts.hab.3.8: Warst du nicht zornig, HERR, in der Flut und dein Grimm in den Wassern und dein Zorn im Meer, da du auf deinen Rossen rittest und deine Wagen den Sieg behielten?
texts.hab.3.9: Du zogst den Bogen hervor, wie du geschworen hattest den Stämmen (sela!), und verteiltest die Ströme ins Land.
texts.hab.3.10: Die Berge sahen dich, und ihnen ward bange; der Wasserstrom fuhr dahin, die Tiefe ließ sich hören, die Höhe hob die Hände auf.
texts.hab.3.11: Sonne und Mond standen still. Deine Pfeile fuhren mit Glänzen dahin und dein Speere mit Leuchten des Blitzes.
texts.hab.3.12: Du zertratest das Land im Zorn und zerdroschest die Heiden im Grimm.
texts.hab.3.13: Du zogst aus, deinem Volk zu helfen, zu helfen deinem Gesalbten; du zerschmettertest das Haupt im Hause des Gottlosen und entblößtest die Grundfeste bis an den Hals. (Sela.)
texts.hab.3.14: Du durchbohrtest mit seinen Speeren das Haupt seiner Scharen, die wie ein Wetter kamen, mich zu zerstreuen, und freuten sich, als fräßen sie die Elenden im Verborgenen.
texts.hab.3.15: Deine Rosse gingen im Meer, im Schlamm großer Wasser.
texts.hab.3.16: Weil ich solches hörte, bebt mein Leib, meine Lippen zittern von dem Geschrei; Eiter geht in meine Gebeine, und meine Kniee beben, dieweil ich ruhig harren muß bis auf die Zeit der Trübsal, da wir hinaufziehen zum Volk, das uns bestreitet.
texts.hab.3.17: Denn der Feigenbaum wird nicht grünen, und wird kein Gewächs sein an den Weinstöcken; die Arbeit am Ölbaum ist vergeblich, und die Äcker bringen keine Nahrung; und Schafe werden aus den Hürden gerissen, und werden keine Rinder in den Ställen sein.
texts.hab.3.18: Aber ich will mich freuen des HERRN und fröhlich sein in Gott, meinem Heil.
texts.hab.3.19: Denn der HERR ist meine Kraft und wird meine Füße machen wie Hirschfüße und wird mich auf meine Höhen führen. Vorzusingen auf meinem Saitenspiel.

texts.hab.1.1: Пророческое видение, которое видел пророк Аввакум.
texts.hab.1.2: Доколе, Господи, я буду взывать, и Ты не слышишь, буду вопиять к Тебе о насилии, и Ты не спасаешь?
texts.hab.1.3: Для чего даешь мне видеть злодейство и смотреть на бедствия? Грабительство и насилие предо мною, и восстает вражда и поднимается раздор.
texts.hab.1.4: От этого закон потерял силу, и суда правильного нет: так как нечестивый одолевает праведного, то и суд происходит превратный.
texts.hab.1.5: Посмотрите между народами и внимательно вглядитесь, и вы сильно изумитесь; ибо Я сделаю во дни ваши такое дело, которому вы не поверили бы, если бы вам рассказывали.
texts.hab.1.6: Ибо вот, Я подниму Халдеев, народ жестокий и необузданный, который ходит по широтам земли, чтобы завладеть не принадлежащими ему селениями.
texts.hab.1.7: Страшен и грозен он; от него самого происходит суд его и власть его.
texts.hab.1.8: Быстрее барсов кони его и прытче вечерних волков; скачет в разные стороны конница его; издалека приходят всадники его, прилетают как орел, бросающийся на добычу.
texts.hab.1.9: Весь он идет для грабежа; устремив лице свое вперед, он забирает пленников, как песок.
texts.hab.1.10: И над царями он издевается, и князья служат ему посмешищем; над всякою крепостью он смеется: насыплет осадный вал и берет ее.
texts.hab.1.11: Тогда надмевается дух его, и он ходит и буйствует; сила его - бог его.
texts.hab.1.12: Но не Ты ли издревле Господь Бог мой, Святый мой? мы не умрем! Ты, Господи, только для суда попустил его. Скала моя! для наказания Ты назначил его.
texts.hab.1.13: Чистым очам Твоим не свойственно глядеть на злодеяния, и смотреть на притеснение Ты не можешь; для чего же Ты смотришь на злодеев и безмолвствуешь, когда нечестивец поглощает того, кто праведнее его,
texts.hab.1.14: и оставляешь людей как рыбу в море, как пресмыкающихся, у которых нет властителя?
texts.hab.1.15: Всех их таскает удою, захватывает в сеть свою и забирает их в неводы свои, и оттого радуется и торжествует.
texts.hab.1.16: За то приносит жертвы сети своей и кадит неводу своему, потому что от них тучна часть его и роскошна пища его.
texts.hab.1.17: Неужели для этого он должен опорожнять свою сеть и непрестанно избивать народы без пощады?
texts.hab.2.1: На стражу мою стал я и, стоя на башне, наблюдал, чтобы узнать, что скажет Он во мне, и что мне отвечать по жалобе моей?
texts.hab.2.2: И отвечал мне Господь и сказал: запиши видение и начертай ясно на скрижалях, чтобы читающий легко мог прочитать,
texts.hab.2.3: ибо видение относится еще к определенному времени и говорит о конце и не обманет; и хотя бы и замедлило, жди его, ибо непременно сбудется, не отменится.
texts.hab.2.4: Вот, душа надменная не успокоится, а праведный своею верою жив будет.
texts.hab.2.5: Надменный человек, как бродящее вино, не успокаивается, так что расширяет душу свою как ад, и как смерть он ненасытен, и собирает к себе все народы, и захватывает себе все племена.
texts.hab.2.6: Но не все ли они будут произносить о нем притчу и насмешливую песнь: "горе тому, кто без меры обогащает себя не своим, - на долго ли? - и обременяет себя залогами!"
texts.hab.2.7: Не восстанут ли внезапно те, которые будут терзать тебя, и не поднимутся ли против тебя грабители, и ты достанешься им на расхищение?
texts.hab.2.8: Так как ты ограбил многие народы, то и тебя ограбят все остальные народы за пролитие крови человеческой, за разорение страны, города и всех живущих в нем.
texts.hab.2.9: Горе тому, кто жаждет неправедных приобретений для дома своего, чтобы устроить гнездо свое на высоте и тем обезопасить себя от руки несчастья!
texts.hab.2.10: Бесславие измыслил ты для твоего дома, истребляя многие народы, и согрешил против души твоей.
texts.hab.2.11: Камни из стен возопиют и перекладины из дерева будут отвечать им:
texts.hab.2.12: "горе строящему город на крови и созидающему крепости неправдою!"
texts.hab.2.13: Вот, не от Господа ли Саваофа это, что народы трудятся для огня и племена мучат себя напрасно?
texts.hab.2.14: Ибо земля наполнится познанием славы Господа, как воды наполняют море.
texts.hab.2.15: Горе тебе, который подаешь ближнему твоему питье с примесью злобы твоей и делаешь его пьяным, чтобы видеть срамоту его!
texts.hab.2.16: Ты пресытился стыдом вместо славы; пей же и ты и показывай срамоту, - обратится и к тебе чаша десницы Господней и посрамление на славу твою.
texts.hab.2.17: Ибо злодейство твое на Ливане обрушится на тебя за истребление устрашенных животных, за пролитие крови человеческой, за опустошение страны, города и всех живущих в нем.
texts.hab.2.18: Что за польза от истукана, сделанного художником, этого литаго лжеучителя, хотя ваятель, делая немые кумиры, полагается на свое произведение?
texts.hab.2.19: Горе тому, кто говорит дереву: "встань!" и бессловесному камню: "пробудись!" Научит ли он чему-нибудь? Вот, он обложен золотом и серебром, но дыхания в нем нет.
texts.hab.2.20: А Господь - во святом храме Своем: да молчит вся земля пред лицем Его!
texts.hab.3.2: Господи! услышал я слух Твой и убоялся. Господи! соверши дело Твое среди лет, среди лет яви его; во гневе вспомни о милости.
texts.hab.3.3: Бог от Фемана грядет и Святый - от горы Фаран. Покрыло небеса величие Его, и славою Его наполнилась земля.
texts.hab.3.4: Блеск ее - как солнечный свет; от руки Его лучи, и здесь тайник Его силы!
texts.hab.3.5: Пред лицем Его идет язва, а по стопам Его - жгучий ветер.
texts.hab.3.6: Он стал и поколебал землю; воззрел, и в трепет привел народы; вековые горы распались, первобытные холмы опали; пути Его вечные.
texts.hab.3.7: Грустными видел я шатры Ефиопские; сотряслись палатки земли Мадиамской.
texts.hab.3.8: Разве на реки воспылал, Господи, гнев Твой? разве на реки - негодование Твое, или на море - ярость Твоя, что Ты восшел на коней Твоих, на колесницы Твои спасительные?
texts.hab.3.9: Ты обнажил лук Твой по клятвенному обетованию, данному коленам. Ты потоками рассек землю.
texts.hab.3.10: Увидев Тебя, вострепетали горы, ринулись воды; бездна дала голос свой, высоко подняла руки свои;
texts.hab.3.11: солнце и луна остановились на месте своем пред светом летающих стрел Твоих, пред сиянием сверкающих копьев Твоих.
texts.hab.3.12: Во гневе шествуешь Ты по земле и в негодовании попираешь народы.
texts.hab.3.13: Ты выступаешь для спасения народа Твоего, для спасения помазанного Твоего. Ты сокрушаешь главу нечестивого дома, обнажая его от основания до верха.
texts.hab.3.14: Ты пронзаешь копьями его главу вождей его, когда они как вихрь ринулись разбить меня, в радости, как бы думая поглотить бедного скрытно.
texts.hab.3.15: Ты с конями Твоими проложил путь по морю, через пучину великих вод.
texts.hab.3.16: Я услышал, и вострепетала внутренность моя; при вести о сем задрожали губы мои, боль проникла в кости мои, и колеблется место подо мною; а я должен быть спокоен в день бедствия, когда придет на народ мой грабитель его.
texts.hab.3.17: Хотя бы не расцвела смоковница и не было плода на виноградных лозах, и маслина изменила, и нива не дала пищи, хотя бы не стало овец в загоне и рогатого скота в стойлах, -
texts.hab.3.18: но и тогда я буду радоваться о Господе и веселиться о Боге спасения моего.
texts.hab.3.19: Господь Бог - сила моя: Он сделает ноги мои как у оленя и на высоты мои возведет меня! [Начальнику хора.]

texts.hab.1.1: A carga que viu o propheta Habacuc.
texts.hab.1.2: Até quando, Senhor, clamarei eu, e tu não me escutarás? até quando gritarei a ti: Violencia! e não salvarás?
texts.hab.1.3: Por que razão me fazes vêr a iniquidade, e vês a vexação? porque a destruição e a violencia estão diante de mim, havendo tambem quem suscite a contenda e o litigio.
texts.hab.1.4: Por esta causa a lei se afrouxa, e a sentença nunca sae; porque o impio cérca o justo, e sae a sentença torcida.
texts.hab.1.5: Vêde entre as nações, e olhae, e maravilhae-vos, e estae maravilhados; porque obro uma obra em vossos dias que não crereis, quando se vos contar.
texts.hab.1.6: Porque eis que suscito os chaldeos, nação amarga e apressada, que marcha sobre a largura da terra, para possuir moradas que não são suas.
texts.hab.1.7: Horrivel e terrivel é; d’ella mesma sairá o seu juizo e a sua grandeza.
texts.hab.1.8: E os seus cavallos são mais ligeiros do que os leopardos, e mais perspicazes do que os lobos á tarde, e os seus cavalleiros se espalham; os seus cavalleiros virão de longe; voarão como aguias que se apressam á comida.
texts.hab.1.9: Elles todos virão a fim de obrar violencia: os seus rostos buscarão o oriente, e congregará os captivos como areia.
texts.hab.1.10: E escarnecerão dos reis, e dos principes farão zombaria: elles se rirão de todas as fortalezas, porque amontoarão terra, e as tomarão.
texts.hab.1.11: Então passará como vento, e traspassará, e se fará culpada, attribuindo este seu poder ao seu deus.
texts.hab.1.12: Porventura não és tu desde sempre, ó Senhor meu Deus, meu Sancto? nós não morreremos: ó Senhor, para juizo o pozeste, e tu, ó Rocha, o fundaste para castigar.
texts.hab.1.13: Tu és tão puro de olhos, que não podes vêr o mal, e a vexação não podes contemplar: porque olhas para os que obram aleivosamente? porque te calas quando o impio devora aquelle que é mais justo do que elle?
texts.hab.1.14: E porque farias os homens como os peixes do mar, como os reptis, que não teem quem os governe?
texts.hab.1.15: Elle a todos tira com o anzol, apanhal-os-ha com a sua rede, e os ajunta na sua varredoura: por isso elle se alegra e se regozija.
texts.hab.1.16: Por isso sacrifica á sua rede, e queima incenso á sua varredoura; porque com ellas se engordou a sua porção, e se engrossou a sua comida.
texts.hab.1.17: Porventura por isso vazará a sua rede, e não poupará de matar os povos continuamente?
texts.hab.2.1: Sobre a minha guarda estarei, e sobre a fortaleza me apresentarei e vigiarei, para vêr o que fallaria em mim, e o que eu responderei, quando eu fôr arguido.
texts.hab.2.2: Então o Senhor me respondeu, e disse: Escreve a visão, e declara-a em taboas, para que n’ellas leia o que correndo passa.
texts.hab.2.3: Porque a visão ainda está para o tempo determinado, pois até ao fim fallará, e não mentirá: se tardar, espera-o, porque certamente virá, nem tardará.
texts.hab.2.4: Eis que de preguiça se retira, não é recta n’elle; mas o justo pela sua fé viverá.
texts.hab.2.5: Quanto mais se é dado ao vinho mais desleal se é; aquelle homem soberbo, que alarga como o sepulchro a sua alma, não permanecerá e é como a morte que não se farta, e ajunta a si todas as nações, e congrega a si todos os povos.
texts.hab.2.6: Não levantariam pois todos estes contra elle uma parabola e dito agudo com enigmas para elle? e se dirá: Ai d’aquelle que multiplica o que não é seu! (até quando!) e d’aquelle que carrega sobre si divida!
texts.hab.2.7: Porventura não se levantarão de repente os que te morderão? e não despertarão os que te abalarão? e não lhes servirás tu de despojo?
texts.hab.2.8: Porquanto despojaste a muitas nações, todos os mais povos te despojarão a ti, por causa do sangue dos homens, e da violencia ácerca da terra da cidade, e de todos os que habitam n’ella.
texts.hab.2.9: Ai d’aquelle que ajunta bens para a sua casa, por uma avareza criminosa, para que ponha o seu ninho no alto, a fim de se livrar da mão do mal!
texts.hab.2.10: Vergonha maquinaste para a tua casa; destruindo tu a muitos povos, peccaste contra a tua alma.
texts.hab.2.11: Porque a pedra clamará da parede, e a trave lhe responderá do madeiramento.
texts.hab.2.12: Ai d’aquelle que edifica a cidade com sangue, e que funda a cidade com iniquidade!
texts.hab.2.13: Eis que porventura não vem do Senhor dos Exercitos que os povos trabalham pelo fogo e os homens se cançam em vão?
texts.hab.2.14: Porque a terra sera cheia do conhecimento da gloria do Senhor, como as aguas cobrem o mar.
texts.hab.2.15: Ai d’aquelle que dá de beber ao seu companheiro! tu, que lhe chegas o teu odre, e o embebedas, para vêr a sua nudez!
texts.hab.2.16: Tambem tu serás farto de ignominia em logar de honra: bebe tu tambem, e descobre o prepucio: o calix da mão direita do Senhor voltará a ti, e vomito ignominioso cairá sobre a tua gloria.
texts.hab.2.17: Porque a violencia commettida contra o Libano te cobrirá, e a destruição das bestas os assombrará, por causa do sangue dos homens, e da violencia feita á terra, á cidade, e a todos os moradores.
texts.hab.2.18: Que aproveitará a imagem de esculptura, depois de que a esculpiu o seu artifice? ou a imagem de fundição, que ensina a mentira, para que o artifice confie na obra, fazendo idolos mudos?
texts.hab.2.19: Ai d’aquelle que diz ao pau: Acorda; e á pedra muda: Desperta; porventura ensinará? eis que está coberto de oiro e de prata, mas no meio d’elle não ha espirito algum.
texts.hab.2.20: Porém o Senhor está no seu sancto templo: cale-se diante d’elle toda a terra.
texts.hab.3.1: Oração do propheta Habacuc sobre Shigionoth.
texts.hab.3.2: Ouvi, Senhor, a tua palavra, e temi: aviva, ó Senhor, a tua obra no meio dos annos, no meio dos annos a notifica: na tua ira lembra-te de misericordia.
texts.hab.3.3: Deus veiu de Teman, e o Sancto do monte de Paran (Selah). A sua gloria cobriu os céus, e a terra foi cheia do seu louvor.
texts.hab.3.4: E o resplandor se fez como a luz, raios brilhantes lhe sahiam da sua mão, e ali estava o esconderijo da sua força.
texts.hab.3.5: Diante d’elle ia a peste, e queimaduras passavam diante dos seus pés.
texts.hab.3.6: Parou, e mediu a terra: olhou, e fez sair as nações: e os montes perpetuos foram esmiuçados; os outeiros eternos se encurvaram, porque o andar eterno é seu.
texts.hab.3.7: Vi as tendas de Cusan debaixo da vaidade: as cortinas da terra de Midian tremiam.
texts.hab.3.8: Acaso é contra os rios, Senhor, que tu estás irado? contra os ribeiros foi a tua ira? contra o mar foi o teu furor, quando andaste montado sobre os teus cavallos? os teus carros foram a salvação?
texts.hab.3.9: Descoberto se despertou o teu arco, pelos juramentos feitos ás tribus, pela tua palavra (Selah). Tu fendeste a terra com rios.
texts.hab.3.10: Os montes te viram, e tremeram: a inundação das aguas passou; deu o abysmo a sua voz, levantou as suas mãos ao alto.
texts.hab.3.11: O sol e a lua pararam nas suas moradas: andaram á luz das tuas frechas, ao resplandor do relampago da tua lança.
texts.hab.3.12: Com indignação marchaste pela terra, com ira trilhaste as nações.
texts.hab.3.13: Tu saiste para salvamento do teu povo, para salvamento do teu ungido: tu feriste a cabeça da casa do impio, descobrindo o alicerce até ao pescoço (Selah).
texts.hab.3.14: Tu furaste com os teus cajados a cabeça das suas aldeias; elles me accommetteram tempestuosos para me espalharem: alegravam-se, como se estivessem para devorar o pobre em segredo.
texts.hab.3.15: Tu com os teus cavallos marchaste pelo mar, pelo montão de grandes aguas.
texts.hab.3.16: Ouvindo-o eu, o meu ventre se commoveu, á sua voz tremeram os meus labios; entrou a podridão nos meus ossos, e estremeci dentro de mim; no dia da angustia descançarei, quando subir contra o povo que nos destruirá.
texts.hab.3.17: Porque ainda que a figueira não floresça, nem haja fructo na vide; o producto da oliveira minta, e os campos não produzam mantimento; as ovelhas da malhada sejam arrebatadas, e nos curraes não haja vaccas:
texts.hab.3.18: Todavia eu me alegrarei no Senhor: gozar-me-hei no Deus da minha salvação.
texts.hab.3.19: Jehovah, o Senhor, é minha força, e fará os meus pés como os das cervas, e me fará andar sobre as minhas alturas. Para o cantor-mór sobre os meus instrumentos de musica.

texts.hab.1.1: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
texts.hab.1.2: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out to thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
texts.hab.1.3: Why dost thou show me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for devastation and violence are before me: and there are that raise strife and contention.
texts.hab.1.4: Therefore the law is slackened, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth encompass the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
texts.hab.1.5: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvelously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe though it be told you.
texts.hab.1.6: For lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwelling-places that are not theirs.
texts.hab.1.7: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed from themselves.
texts.hab.1.8: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
texts.hab.1.9: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
texts.hab.1.10: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn to them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
texts.hab.1.11: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power to his god.
texts.hab.1.12: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
texts.hab.1.13: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: why lookest thou on them that deal treacherously, and keepest silence when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
texts.hab.1.14: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping animals that have no ruler over them?
texts.hab.1.15: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
texts.hab.1.16: Therefore they sacrifice to their net, and burn incense to their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their food plenteous.
texts.hab.1.17: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
texts.hab.2.1: I will stand upon my watch, and seat myself upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say to me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
texts.hab.2.2: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
texts.hab.2.3: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it may tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
texts.hab.2.4: Behold, his soul which is lifted up, is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
texts.hab.2.5: Yes also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire, as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth to him all nations, and collecteth to him all people:
texts.hab.2.6: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
texts.hab.2.7: Shall they not rise suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall disturb thee, and thou shalt be for booties to them?
texts.hab.2.8: Because thou hast laid waste many nations, all the remnant of the people shall lay thee waste; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
texts.hab.2.9: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
texts.hab.2.10: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
texts.hab.2.11: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
texts.hab.2.12: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and establisheth a city by iniquity!
texts.hab.2.13: Behold, is it not from the LORD of hosts that the people shall labor in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
texts.hab.2.14: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
texts.hab.2.15: Woe to him that giveth his neighbor drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
texts.hab.2.16: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD'S right hand shall be turned to thee, and shameful vomiting shall be on thy glory.
texts.hab.2.17: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
texts.hab.2.18: What profiteth the graven image that its maker hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
texts.hab.2.19: Woe to him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
texts.hab.2.20: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
texts.hab.3.1: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
texts.hab.3.2: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
texts.hab.3.3: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
texts.hab.3.4: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand; and there was the hiding of his power.
texts.hab.3.5: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
texts.hab.3.6: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
texts.hab.3.7: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian trembled.
texts.hab.3.8: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thy anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thy horses, and thy chariots of salvation?
texts.hab.3.9: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
texts.hab.3.10: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
texts.hab.3.11: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thy arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
texts.hab.3.12: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
texts.hab.3.13: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thy anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by uncovering the foundation to the neck. Selah.
texts.hab.3.14: Thou didst strike through with his staffs the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
texts.hab.3.15: Thou didst walk through the sea with thy horses, through the mire of great waters.
texts.hab.3.16: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up to the people, he will invade them with his troops.
texts.hab.3.17: Although the fig-tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no food; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
texts.hab.3.18: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
texts.hab.3.19: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon my high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

texts.hab.1.1: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
texts.hab.1.2: Jehovah, how long shall I cry and thou wilt not hear? I cry out unto thee, Violence! and thou dost not save.
texts.hab.1.3: Why dost thou cause me to see iniquity, and lookest thou upon grievance? For spoiling and violence are before me; and there is strife, and contention riseth up.
texts.hab.1.4: Therefore the law is powerless, and justice doth never go forth; for the wicked encompasseth the righteous; therefore judgment goeth forth perverted.
texts.hab.1.5: See ye among the nations, and behold, and wonder marvellously; for [I] work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be declared [to you].
texts.hab.1.6: For behold, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and impetuous nation, which marcheth through the breadth of the earth, to possess dwelling-places that are not theirs.
texts.hab.1.7: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
texts.hab.1.8: And their horses are swifter than the leopards, and are more agile than the evening wolves; and their horsemen prance proudly, and their horsemen come from afar: they fly as an eagle that hasteth to devour.
texts.hab.1.9: They come all of them for violence: the crowd of their faces is forwards, and they gather captives as the sand.
texts.hab.1.10: Yea, he scoffeth at kings, and princes are a scorn unto him; he derideth every stronghold: for he heapeth up dust, and taketh it.
texts.hab.1.11: Then will his mind change, and he will pass on, and become guilty: this his power is become his +god.
texts.hab.1.12: -- Art thou not from everlasting, Jehovah my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. Jehovah, thou hast ordained him for judgment; and thou, O Rock, hast appointed him for correction.
texts.hab.1.13: [Thou art] of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on mischief: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, [and] keepest silence when the wicked swalloweth up a [man] more righteous than he?
texts.hab.1.14: And thou makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them.
texts.hab.1.15: He taketh up all of them with the hook, he catcheth them in his net, and gathereth them into his drag; therefore he rejoiceth and is glad:
texts.hab.1.16: therefore he sacrificeth unto his net, and burneth incense unto his drag; for by them his portion is become fat, and his meat dainty.
texts.hab.1.17: Shall he therefore empty his net, and not spare to slay the nations continually?
texts.hab.2.1: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will look forth to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer as to my reproof.
texts.hab.2.2: And Jehovah answered me and said, Write the vision, and engrave it upon tablets, that he may run that readeth it.
texts.hab.2.3: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but it hasteth to the end, and shall not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; for it will surely come, it will not delay.
texts.hab.2.4: Behold, his soul is puffed up, it is not upright within him: but the just shall live by his faith.
texts.hab.2.5: And moreover, the wine is treacherous: he is a proud man, and keepeth not at rest, he enlargeth his desire as Sheol, and he is like death and cannot be satisfied; and he assembleth unto him all nations, and gathereth unto him all peoples.
texts.hab.2.6: Shall not all these take up a proverb about him, and a taunting riddle against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? -- and to him that loadeth himself with pledges!
texts.hab.2.7: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and they awake up that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
texts.hab.2.8: Because thou hast plundered many nations, all the rest of the peoples shall plunder thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence [done] to the land, to the city, and all that dwell therein.
texts.hab.2.9: Woe to him that getteth iniquitous gain to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the grasp of evil!
texts.hab.2.10: Thou hast devised shame to thy house, by cutting off many peoples, and hast sinned against thine own soul.
texts.hab.2.11: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
texts.hab.2.12: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and establisheth a city by unrighteousness!
texts.hab.2.13: Behold, is it not of Jehovah of hosts that the peoples labour for the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?
texts.hab.2.14: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Jehovah as the waters cover the sea.
texts.hab.2.15: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, -- that pourest out thy flask, and makest [him] drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
texts.hab.2.16: Thou art filled with shame instead of glory; drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of Jehovah's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and a shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
texts.hab.2.17: For the violence [done] to Lebanon shall cover thee, and the destruction of beasts which made them afraid; because of men's blood, and for the violence [done] to the land, to the city, and all that dwell therein.
texts.hab.2.18: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it? the molten image, and the teacher of falsehood, that the maker of his work dependeth thereon, to make dumb idols?
texts.hab.2.19: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake! to the dumb stone, Arise! Shall it teach? Behold it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
texts.hab.2.20: But Jehovah is in his holy temple. Let all the earth keep silence before him!
texts.hab.3.1: A Prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
texts.hab.3.2: Jehovah, I heard the report of thee, [and] I feared. Jehovah, revive thy work in the midst of the years, In the midst of the years make [it] known: In wrath remember mercy!
texts.hab.3.3: +God came from Teman, And the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covereth the heavens, And the earth is full of his praise.
texts.hab.3.4: And [his] brightness was as the light; Rays [came forth] from his hand; And there was the hiding of his power.
texts.hab.3.5: Before him went the pestilence, And a burning flame went forth at his feet.
texts.hab.3.6: He stood, and measured the earth; He beheld, and discomfited the nations; And the eternal mountains were scattered, The everlasting hills gave way: His ways are everlasting.
texts.hab.3.7: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
texts.hab.3.8: Was Jehovah wrathful with the rivers? Was thine anger against the rivers? Was thy rage against the sea, That thou didst ride upon thy horses, Thy chariots of salvation?
texts.hab.3.9: Thy bow was made naked, The rods [of discipline] sworn according to [thy] word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
texts.hab.3.10: The mountains saw thee, they were in travail: Torrents of waters passed by; The deep uttered its voice, Lifted up its hands on high.
texts.hab.3.11: The sun [and] moon stood still in their habitation, At the light of thine arrows which shot forth, -- At the shining of thy glittering spear.
texts.hab.3.12: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, Thou didst thresh the nations in anger.
texts.hab.3.13: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, For the salvation of thine anointed; Thou didst smite off the head from the house of the wicked, Laying bare the foundation even to the neck. Selah.
texts.hab.3.14: Thou didst strike through with his own spears the head of his leaders: They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me, Whose exulting was as to devour the afflicted secretly.
texts.hab.3.15: Thou didst walk through the sea with thy horses, The heap of great waters.
texts.hab.3.16: I heard, and my belly trembled; My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in my place, That I might rest in the day of distress, When their invader shall come up against the people.
texts.hab.3.17: For though the fig-tree shall not blossom, Neither shall fruit be in the vines; The labour of the olive-tree shall fail, And the fields shall yield no food; The flock shall be cut off from the fold, And there shall be no herd in the stalls:
texts.hab.3.18: Yet I will rejoice in Jehovah, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
texts.hab.3.19: Jehovah, the Lord, is my strength, And he maketh my feet like hinds' [feet], And he will make me to walk upon my high places. To the chief Musician. On my stringed instruments.

texts.hab.1.1: The burden that Habakkuk the prophet hath seen:
texts.hab.1.2: Till when, O Jehovah, have I cried, And Thou dost not hear? I cry unto Thee -- `Violence,' and Thou dost not save.
texts.hab.1.3: Why dost Thou shew me iniquity, And perversity dost cause to behold? And spoiling and violence [are] before me, And there is strife, and contention doth lift [itself] up,
texts.hab.1.4: Therefore doth law cease, And judgment doth not go forth for ever, For the wicked is compassing the righteous, Therefore wrong judgment goeth forth.
texts.hab.1.5: Look ye on nations, and behold and marvel greatly. For a work He is working in your days, Ye do not believe though it is declared.
texts.hab.1.6: For, lo, I am raising up the Chaldeans, The bitter and hasty nation, That is going to the broad places of earth, To occupy tabernacles not its own.
texts.hab.1.7: Terrible and fearful it [is], From itself its judgment and its excellency go forth.
texts.hab.1.8: Swifter than leopards have been its horses, And sharper than evening wolves, And increased have its horsemen, Even its horsemen from afar come in, They fly as an eagle, hasting to consume.
texts.hab.1.9: Wholly for violence it doth come in, Their faces swallowing up the east wind, And it doth gather as the sand a captivity.
texts.hab.1.10: And at kings it doth scoff, And princes [are] a laughter to it, At every fenced place it doth laugh, And it heapeth up dust, and captureth it.
texts.hab.1.11: Then passed on hath the spirit, Yea, he doth transgress, And doth ascribe this his power to his god.
texts.hab.1.12: Art not Thou of old, O Jehovah, my God, my Holy One? We do not die, O Jehovah, For judgment Thou hast appointed it, And, O Rock, for reproof Thou hast founded it.
texts.hab.1.13: Purer of eyes than to behold evil, To look on perverseness Thou art not able, Why dost Thou behold the treacherous? Thou keepest silent when the wicked Doth swallow the more righteous than he,
texts.hab.1.14: And Thou makest man as fishes of the sea, As a creeping thing -- none ruling over him.
texts.hab.1.15: Each of them with a hook he hath brought up, He doth catch it in his net, and gathereth it in his drag, Therefore he doth joy and rejoice.
texts.hab.1.16: Therefore he doth sacrifice to his net, And doth make perfume to his drag, For by them [is] his portion fertile, and his food fat.
texts.hab.1.17: Doth he therefore empty his net, And continually to slay nations spare not?
texts.hab.2.1: On my charge I stand, and I station myself on a bulwark, and I watch to see what He doth speak against me, and what I do reply to my reproof.
texts.hab.2.2: And Jehovah answereth me and saith: `Write a vision, and explain on the tables, That he may run who is reading it.
texts.hab.2.3: For yet the vision [is] for a season, And it breatheth for the end, and doth not lie, If it tarry, wait for it, For surely it cometh, it is not late.
texts.hab.2.4: Lo, a presumptuous one! Not upright is his soul within him, And the righteous by his stedfastness liveth.
texts.hab.2.5: And also, because the wine [is] treacherous, A man is haughty, and remaineth not at home, Who hath enlarged as sheol his soul, And is as death that is not satisfied, And doth gather unto itself all the nations, And doth assemble unto itself all the peoples,
texts.hab.2.6: Do not these -- all of them -- against him a simile taken up, And a moral of acute sayings for him, And say, Wo [to] him who is multiplying [what is] not his? Till when also is he multiplying to himself heavy pledges?
texts.hab.2.7: Do not thy usurers instantly rise up, And those shaking thee awake up, And thou hast been for a spoil to them?
texts.hab.2.8: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, Spoil thee do all the remnant of the peoples, Because of man's blood, and of violence [to] the land, [To] the city, and [to] all dwelling in it.
texts.hab.2.9: Wo [to] him who is gaining evil gain for his house, To set on high his nest, To be delivered from the hand of evil,
texts.hab.2.10: Thou hast counselled a shameful thing to thy house, To cut off many peoples, and sinful [is] thy soul.
texts.hab.2.11: For a stone from the wall doth cry out, And a holdfast from the wood answereth it.
texts.hab.2.12: Wo [to] him who is building a city by blood, And establishing a city by iniquity.
texts.hab.2.13: Lo, is it not from Jehovah of Hosts And peoples are fatigued for fire, And nations for vanity are weary?
texts.hab.2.14: For full is the earth of the knowledge of the honour of Jehovah, As waters cover [the bottom of] a sea.
texts.hab.2.15: Wo [to] him who is giving drink to his neighbour, Pouring out thy bottle, and also making drunk, In order to look on their nakedness.
texts.hab.2.16: Thou hast been filled -- shame without honour, Drink thou also, and be uncircumcised, Turn round unto thee doth the cup of the right hand of Jehovah, And shameful spewing [is] on thine honour.
texts.hab.2.17: For violence [to] Lebanon doth cover thee, And spoil of beasts doth affright them, Because of man's blood, and of violence [to] the land, [To] the city, and [to] all dwelling in it.
texts.hab.2.18: What profit hath a graven image given That its former hath graven it? A molten image and teacher of falsehood, That trusted hath the former on his own formation -- to make dumb idols?
texts.hab.2.19: Wo [to] him who is saying to wood, `Awake,' `Stir up,' to a dumb stone, It a teacher! lo, it is overlaid -- gold and silver, And there is no spirit in its midst.
texts.hab.2.20: And Jehovah [is] in His holy temple, Be silent before Him, all the earth!
texts.hab.3.1: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet concerning erring ones:
texts.hab.3.2: O Jehovah, I heard thy report, I have been afraid, O Jehovah, Thy work! in midst of years revive it, In the midst of years Thou makest known In anger Thou dost remember mercy.
texts.hab.3.3: God from Teman doth come, The Holy One from mount Paran. Pause! Covered the heavens hath His majesty, And His praise hath filled the earth.
texts.hab.3.4: And the brightness is as the light, He hath rays out of His hand, And there -- the hiding of His strength.
texts.hab.3.5: Before Him goeth pestilence, And a burning flame goeth forth at His feet.
texts.hab.3.6: He hath stood, and He measureth earth, He hath seen, and He shaketh off nations, And scatter themselves do mountains of antiquity, Bowed have the hills of old, The ways of old [are] His.
texts.hab.3.7: Under sorrow I have seen tents of Cushan, Tremble do curtains of the land of Midian.
texts.hab.3.8: Against rivers hath Jehovah been wroth? Against rivers [is] Thine anger? Against the sea [is] Thy wrath? For Thou dost ride on Thy horses -- Thy chariots of salvation?
texts.hab.3.9: Utterly naked Thou dost make Thy bow, Sworn are the tribes -- saying, `Pause!' [With] rivers Thou dost cleave the earth.
texts.hab.3.10: Seen thee -- pained are mountains, An inundation of waters hath passed over, Given forth hath the deep its voice, High its hands it hath lifted up.
texts.hab.3.11: Sun -- moon -- hath stood -- a habitation, At the light thine arrows go on, At the brightness, the glittering of thy spear.
texts.hab.3.12: In indignation Thou dost tread earth, In anger Thou dost thresh nations.
texts.hab.3.13: Thou hast gone forth for the salvation of Thy people, For salvation with Thine anointed, Thou hast smitten the head of the house of the wicked, Laying bare the foundation unto the neck. Pause!
texts.hab.3.14: Thou hast pierced with his staves the head of his leaders, They are tempestuous to scatter me, Their exultation [is] as to consume the poor in secret.
texts.hab.3.15: Thou hast proceeded through the sea with Thy horses -- the clay of many waters.
texts.hab.3.16: I have heard, and my belly trembleth, At the noise have my lips quivered, Rottenness doth come into my bones, And in my place I do tremble, That I rest for a day of distress, At the coming up of the people, he overcometh it.
texts.hab.3.17: Though the fig-tree doth not flourish, And there is no produce among vines, Failed hath the work of the olive, And fields have not yielded food, Cut off from the fold hath been the flock, And there is no herd in the stalls.
texts.hab.3.18: Yet I, in Jehovah I exult, I do joy in the God of my salvation.
texts.hab.3.19: Jehovah the Lord [is] my strength, And He doth make my feet like hinds, And on my high-places causeth me to tread. To the overseer with my stringed instruments!

texts.hab.1.1: La carga que vio Habacuc profeta.
texts.hab.1.2: ¿Hasta cuándo, o! Jehová, clamaré, y no oirás? ¿daré voces a ti a causa de la violencia, y no salvarás?
texts.hab.1.3: ¿Por qué me haces ver iniquidad, y haces que mire molestia, y que saco y violencia esté delante de mí, y haya quien levante pleito y contienda?
texts.hab.1.4: Por lo cual la ley es debilitada, y el juicio no sale perpetuo; porque el impío calumnia al justo: a esta causa el juicio sale torcido.
texts.hab.1.5: Mirád en las gentes, y ved, y maravilláos, maravilláos; porque obra será hecha en vuestros días, que cuando se os contare, no la creeréis.
texts.hab.1.6: Porque he aquí que yo levanto los Caldeos, nación amarga y presurosa, que camina por la anchura de la tierra para poseer las habitaciones ajenas.
texts.hab.1.7: Espantosa y terrible, de ella misma saldrá su derecho y su grandeza.
texts.hab.1.8: Y serán sus caballos más ligeros que tigres, y más agudos que lobos de tarde; y sus caballeros se multiplicarán: vendrán de lejos sus caballeros, y volarán como águilas que se apresuran a la comida.
texts.hab.1.9: Toda ella vendrá a la presa: delante de sus caras viento solano; y ayuntará cautivos como arena.
texts.hab.1.10: Y él escarnecerá de los reyes, y de los príncipes hará burla: él se reirá de toda fortaleza, y amontanará polvo, y la tomará.
texts.hab.1.11: Entonces él mudará espíritu, y traspasará, y pecará atribuyendo esta su potencia a su dios.
texts.hab.1.12: ¿No eres tú desde el principio, o! Jehová, Dios mío, santo mío? no moriremos, o! Jehová: para juicio le pusiste, y fuerte le fundaste para castigar.
texts.hab.1.13: Limpio de ojos para no ver el mal: ni podrás ver la molestia: ¿por qué ves los menospreciadores, y callas, cuando destruye el impío al más justo que él?
texts.hab.1.14: ¿Y haces que los hombres sean como los peces de la mar, y como reptiles que no tienen señor?
texts.hab.1.15: Sacará a todos con su anzuelo, apañarlos ha con su aljanaya, y juntarlos ha con su red: por lo cual él se holgará, y hará alegrías.
texts.hab.1.16: Por esto sacrificará a su aljanaya, y a su red ofrecerá sahumerios; porque con ellas engordó su porción, y engrasó su comida.
texts.hab.1.17: ¿Vaciará por eso su red, o tendrá piedad de matar naciones continuamente?
texts.hab.2.1: Sobre mi guarda estaré, y sobre la fortaleza afirmaré el pie, y atalayaré para ver qué hablará en mí, y qué tengo de responder a mi pregunta.
texts.hab.2.2: Y Jehová me respondió, y dijo: Escribe la visión, y declárala en tablas, para que corra el que leyere en ella.
texts.hab.2.3: Porque la visión aun tardará por tiempo: mas al fin hablará, y no mentirá. Si se tardare, espéralo: que sin duda vendrá, no tardará.
texts.hab.2.4: He aquí que se enorgullece aquel cuya alma no es derecha en él: mas el justo en su fe vivirá.
texts.hab.2.5: Cuanto mas que el dado al vino, traspasador, hombre soberbio, no permanecerá: que ensanchó como un osario su alma, y es como la muerte que no se hartará: mas congregó a sí todas las naciones, y amontonó a sí todos los pueblos.
texts.hab.2.6: ¿No han de levantar todos estos sobre él parábola, y adivinanzas de él? y dirán: ¡Ay del que multiplicó de lo que no era suyo! ¿Y hasta cuándo había de amontonar sobre sí espeso lodo?
texts.hab.2.7: ¿No se levantarán de repente los que te han de morder, y se despertarán los que te han de quitar de tu lugar, y serás a ellos por rapiña?
texts.hab.2.8: Porque tú despojaste muchas naciones, todos los otros pueblos te despojarán, a causa de las sangres humanas, y robos de la tierra, de las ciudades, y de todos los que moraban en ellas.
texts.hab.2.9: ¡Ay del que codicia la mala codicia para su casa, por poner en alto su nido, por escaparse del poder del mal!
texts.hab.2.10: Tomaste consejo vergonzoso para tu casa, asolaste muchos pueblos, y pecaste contra tu vida.
texts.hab.2.11: Porque la piedra del muro clamará, y la tabla del maderado le responderá.
texts.hab.2.12: ¡Ay del que edifica la ciudad con sangres, y del que funda la villa con iniquidad!
texts.hab.2.13: ¿Esto, no es de Jehová de los ejércitos? por tanto pueblos trabajarán en el fuego, y gentes se fatigarán en vano.
texts.hab.2.14: Porque la tierra será llena de conocimiento de la gloria de Jehová, como las aguas cubren la mar.
texts.hab.2.15: ¡Ay del que da de beber a su compañero, del que allegas cerca tu odre, y emborrachas para mirar después sus desnudeces!
